title: The Hunger Games Books
description:
Join us at Books2Door as we delve into the thrilling and treacherous world of The Hunger Games series by Suzanne Collins. In this dystopian universe where the odds are never in your favour, and every move could be your last, you'll be captivated from the first page. Whether you're a long time fan or new to the series, we've got you covered, ensuring you fall in love with everything this collection offers.

The Hunger Games has captured readers' hearts worldwide, transporting them to the dystopian nation of Panem, where society is divided into districts under the control of a ruthless Capitol. Follow the fearless Katniss Everdeen as she volunteers to take her sister's place in a deadly televised survival game. With each page turn, you'll find yourself on the edge of your seat, immersed in a world of political intrigue, heart-pounding action, and unexpected alliances.

Explore this series with us and discover why The Hunger Games remains a global phenomenon.

The Hunger Games

The Hunger Games kicks off the thrilling series by introducing readers to the dystopian world of Panem, where the Capitol's tyranny looms large. Meet Katniss Everdeen, a resourceful young woman from District 12 who volunteers as a tribute to save her sister from the brutal Hunger Games. In the arena, Katniss faces unimaginable challenges, forming alliances and challenging the Capitol's control over the Districts.

Catching Fire

In Catching Fire, the second instalment of the series, the repercussions of Katniss and Peeta's defiance in the first Hunger Games ripple across Panem. The Capitol is determined to suppress any signs of rebellion, leading to the cruel Quarter Quell, a memorable Hunger Games featuring past victors. Katniss and Peeta are again thrust into the arena, but this time, alliances and loyalties are tested like never before.

Mockingjay

In the explosive conclusion of the trilogy, Mockingjay, Katniss Everdeen becomes the face of the rebellion, the Mockingjay. The Districts rise against the Capitol's oppressive rule, and Katniss takes on the daunting role of leading the charge. The novel delves into the darkest depths of war and the human cost of rebellion, forcing Katniss to confront the consequences of her actions.

A Ballad of Songbirds and Snakes

A Ballad of Songbirds and Snakes takes readers back in time to explore the origins of the Hunger Games and the enigmatic character of Coriolanus Snow. Set during the 10th Hunger Games, this prequel introduces us to a young and ambitious Coriolanus, who mentors District 12's tribute, Lucy Gray Baird. As he navigates a complex and morally ambiguous world, the book offers a deeper understanding of the Capitol's ruthless nature and the events that eventually led to the Hunger Games as we know them. Suzanne Collins skilfully weaves a tale of intrigue, ambition, and the blurred lines between heroism and villainy, providing a captivating backstory to the Panem we've come to know in the original trilogy.

With themes of resilience, love, and the fight for justice, The Hunger Games series is a rollercoaster of emotions that will keep you hooked from start to finish. 

And remember—May the odds be ever in your favour!

title: The Survival Guide for Kids
description:
We all need a guide to coach us as we navigate life and discover new challenges and talents we may possess. We all need help with life, and some need a little extra. At Books2Door, we provide all that we need and a little extra to whoever needs it. Here we are with a collection exclusively for the kids needing extra help, a steadfast ally to guide them through the ups and downs. A collection of resources crafted for young minds navigating the complexities of growing up with neurodevelopmental disorder.

This collection has books that are more than just a series of books. Instead, they are an expert guide to children and their caretakers, offering practical and effective coping mechanisms. They provide actionable advice and unwavering support for youngsters confronting many obstacles, all by child psychology and education experts. Each book in the series is designed to empower children to confront challenges, foster resilience and self-assurance, and promote positive mental well-being, instilling confidence and hope in parents and caretakers. These books are not just tools; they are a source of empowerment for your children, making them feel capable and hopeful. 

The Survival Guide for Kids with ADHD

Navigating school, relationships, and daily tasks can be difficult for children with ADHD or Attention-Deficit/Hyperactivity Disorder; for some, it may feel like a battle. The Survival Guide for Kids with ADHD is a book that will help them navigate life better by offering practical tips for managing impulsivity, improving focus, and harnessing strengths suitable uniquely for those with ADHD. The book also includes tips on organisational skills to cope with frustrations, as well as more resorts that will empower children to thrive while embracing their complete selves and their differences. 

The Survival Guide for Kids with Autism Spectrum Disorder

Social interactions are complex for children and incredibly challenging for some children on the Autism Spectrum. The Survival Guide for Kids with Autism Spectrum Disorder will help those with difficulty with this, as it offers insights to help children on the spectrum understand their strengths, communicate effectively, and better navigate social interactions. The book also includes engaging activities based on real-life scenarios, allowing them to celebrate the perspectives of individuals on the Autism Spectrum. This fosters children's acceptance and resilience in terms of social norms. 

This book provides strategies for understanding your unique experiences and making you feel seen and acknowledged. 

The Survival Guide for Kids with Behavior Challenges

Kids with behavioural challenges face rather significant difficulties as they journey through life, as it is not limited to what they will experience or is socially constructed. Children with these challenges might need extra help figuring out their relationships, academic performance, and maybe even their overall well-being. 

The Survival Guide for Kids with Behavior Challenges offers practical strategies and positive reinforcement techniques to help these children manage emotions, develop self-control, and build healthy relationships. The book aims to promote empathy, self-awareness, and problem-solving skills through the guide that empowers children to overcome behavioural obstacles and cultivate a positive sense of self.

At Books2Door, we understand the importance of providing children with resources that educate, inspire, and uplift them. The Survival Guide for Kids series exemplifies our commitment to supporting children's mental health and well-being, one empowering book at a time. Whether facing ADHD, Autism Spectrum Disorder, or behavioural challenges, every child deserves the opportunity to thrive. With these invaluable guides, they can get better at facing some obstacle that comes their way.

title: The Treehouse Series Books

The stories follow these two friends trying to write a book—but their absurd life keeps getting in the way! It's got a giant catapult, a secret underground laboratory, a tank of man-eating sharks and a marshmallow machine that follows the reader around and shoots marshmallows into their mouth whenever they are hungry! Packed to the brim with flying cats, mermaids, or the sea monsters pretending to be mermaids, or the giant mutant mermaid sea monster; this is the fiction book every child deserves when growing up.

Essentially this book is your child’s Treehouse passport, have your kid grab it and jump into the crazy world of the bestselling Treehouse series by Andy Griffiths and Terry Denton. In this activity book, your child can join Andy, Terry and Jill for an adventure like no other as they combine animals, create magical kingdoms, time-travel, solve crosswords, search for words, colour and scribble, spot the difference, find the odd one out, crack codes and more. So fun!

title: The Wheel of Time Books
description:
Created and written by the legendary Robert Jordan and finished by Brandon Sanderson, The Wheel of Time is one of the best-selling high fantasy novel series of all time with over 90 million copies sold worldwide as of 2021. Collect the entire saga with our affordable box sets featuring all fourteen novels in the highly acclaimed series. We stock the whole series in three great value five-book collections:

  • The Wheel of Time by Robert Jordan: Series 1 Collection (Books 1-5)
  • The Wheel of Time by Robert Jordan: Series 2 Collection (Books 6-10)
  • The Wheel of Time by Robert Jordan: Series 3 Collection (Books 11-15)

The Wheel of Time series:

This renowned series was written by the legendary high fantasy author James Oliver Rigney Jr., under the pen name Robert Jordan. It was a hit with fans of high fantasy literature, focusing predominantly on epic historical settings and strong characters. Having originally been planned as a six-book series, the collection spans over fourteen volumes as well as a prequel novel and two companion books. 

First published in 1990, The Wheel of Time series takes place in our past and our future, with the epic saga telling the story of a man destined to face the Evil One and save the world or destroy it in the process.

At the dawn of time, a deity referred to as the Creator, forged the universe and the Wheel of Time, spilling the Pattern of the Ages using the lives of men and women as its thread. The Creator imprisoned its antithesis “Shai’tan”, meaning the Dark One, at the commencement of creation, sealing him forever away in the Wheel.

However, in the Age of Legends, an experiment unintentionally ruptures the Dark One’s prison, allowing him to rally the corrupt and powerful to his cause in order to remake time and reality his own. But where there is darkness, there must be light if mankind is to be saved from the shadow of the Dark One. 

The Prime Video adaptation of The Wheel of Time premiered in November 2021, with more on the way. Season one largely follows the first book in the series, The Eye of the World.

Fans of Robert Jordan should be sure to check out our extensive range of other high fantasy collections including J. R. R. Tolkien's The Hobbit & The Lord of the Rings series and also George R . R. Martin’s Game of Thrones collection. 

About the Author: 

The Wheel of Time author Robert Jordan began the series in 1990 and wrote the first eleven books in the series, as well as the prequel New Spring. He was working on what was planned to be the final novel in the series, A Memory of Light when he died in 2007. 

Fellow high fantasy author Brandon Sanderson, best known for the Mistborn Trilogy, was chosen to complete the last book in the series. Sanderson followed Jordan’s extensive notes to complete the book according to his final wishes. During the last stages of the writing process, it was decided the final book would be too large to publish in one volume. It was split into three books: The Gathering Storm, Towers of Midnight, and A Memory of Light.

title: Thomas the Tank Engine Books
description:
Discover the Magic of Thomas the Tank Engine Books

Thomas the Tank Engine has been enchanting children for over seventy-five years. He first appeared in the second volume of the Rev. W. Awdry’s Railway Series and soon became its lead character. He was featured in the hit TV series Thomas the Tank Engine & Friends, which ran for 37 years, and the new animated show Thomas & Friends: All Engines Go. He also stars in movies, specials, merchandise, and railway experiences. Thomas has become a name known throughout the world. Still, it all started with an English vicar who became one of the most influential authors ever in kids' books.

Enter a world of adventure, friendship, and imagination with the timeless and beloved Thomas the Tank Engine books. For generations, children and adults alike have been captivated by the endearing tales of Thomas and his railway friends. From the first page to the last, these charming stories, created by Reverend W. Awdry and continued by his son Christopher, transport readers to the enchanting island of Sodor, where trains come to life and embark on exciting journeys.

At the heart of the Thomas the Tank Engine series lies the lovable blue engine himself, Thomas. With his cheerful demeanour and can-do attitude, Thomas has become an iconic character in children's literature. As readers join him on his various escapades, they learn valuable lessons about friendship, teamwork, and the importance of being true to oneself. Through his experiences, Thomas teaches children the power of determination, kindness, and the joy of discovery.

The Thomas the Tank Engine books are not just simple stories but captivating adventures that stimulate the imagination. From meeting new engines to exploring picturesque landscapes, each book presents a new opportunity for young readers to embark on an exciting journey. Children will delight in following Thomas and his friends as they navigate challenges, solve problems, and learn important life lessons along the way.

One of the unique aspects of the Thomas the Tank Engine books is the memorable cast of characters that populate the railway. From the wise and kind Sir Topham Hatt to the mischievous Troublesome Trucks, each character possesses distinct traits and personalities, making them relatable and endearing. Children develop a deep connection with these characters, fostering empathy and understanding as they witness the challenges and triumphs that each one faces.

About the Author:

The Reverend Wilbert Awdry was a railway enthusiast who held a passion for steam engines as a child that lasted the rest of his life. The book series originated when, in 1943, he told a story about a steam engine to his son Christopher, who had developed measles. In the story, little Edward helps Gordon’s train up a hill. Awdry went on to build a model of Edward but didn’t have enough materials to make Gordon. So, he built a smaller engine and named it Thomas. Soon enough, Christopher wanted stories about Thomas, the bright blue engine, and a legend was born.

The Three Railway Engines was published in 1945, and Thomas the Tank Engine the year after. What followed was a series of profound development of delightful and pleasant characters and books filled with unique characters with various qualities and flavours, all set on the wonderful island of Sodor. Along the way, iconic friends such as James, Percy, Edward, and the “Fat Controller” Sir Topham Hatt. Year by year, Awdry worked hard to release new titles, which gave so much happiness and joy to children worldwide. His last book, Tramway Engines, was released in 1972.

Christopher Awdry took over the series in 1983, writing sixteen books, and concluded the series with the 42nd book, Thomas and his Friends. Two companion volumes were also published: 1987’s The Island of Sodor: Its People, History and Railways by Rev. W. Awdry and George Awdry, and 2005’s Sodor: Reading Between the Lines by Christopher Awdry. Also available are annuals, picture book versions of the classic Thomas stories, as well as books that tie into his long-running TV series. 

Thomas the Tank Engine: The Classic Library contains all 26 books in The Railway Series written by The Rev. W. Awdry. Each small hardback book is lovingly illustrated, and the set comes nestled in a bespoke hinged case. The collection is a perfect gift for any Thomas fan who’ll love to read these timeless classics again and again.

We also stock gift sets for other classic children’s characters, including Winnie the Pooh, Peter Rabbit and Paddington. There is also a wide range of books you may know from TV, such as Peppa Pig and Numberblocks. Let us know about your favourite characters over on social media. Make sure you subscribe to our newsletter to ensure you don’t miss out on your new favourite book.

title: Throne of Glass Books
description:
The Throne of Glass book series, written by Sarah J. Maas, has captivated readers worldwide with its compelling characters, intricate plotlines, and richly imagined world. Throne of Glass is an internationally bestselling young adult series. Spanning seven books, this epic fantasy series takes readers on a thrilling journey filled with magic, political intrigue, and the indomitable spirit of its protagonist, Celaena Sardothien. Buy the full Throne of Glass series here at Books2Door in our Throne of Glass by Sarah J Maas 8-book set. 

The series begins with Throne of Glass, introducing us to Celaena, a young assassin who was once feared and revered throughout the land. However, after being captured and serving a year as a slave in the salt mines of Endovier, Celaena is given a chance at freedom. Crown Prince Dorian Havillard offers her a deal: if she competes in a deadly competition to become the King's Champion, she will eventually earn her freedom. Thus begins Celaena's path to redemption, as she navigates the treacherous trials, uncovers dark secrets, and confronts her own haunted past.

All Throne of Glass books in order: 

The Assassin’s Blade (Prequel)

Throne of Glass

Crown of Midnight

Heir of Fire

Queen of Shadows

Empire of Storms

Tower of Dawn

Kingdom of Ash

Sarah J. Maas masterfully weaves together elements of fantasy, romance, and action in the Throne of Glass series. The intricate world-building leaves readers immersed in a realm filled with magic, mythical creatures, and deep-rooted history. From the towering glass castle of Adarlan to the enchanted Fae realm of Wendlyn, each setting is vividly described, allowing readers to easily envision the breathtaking landscapes and bustling cities.

One of the series' greatest strengths lies in its diverse and well-developed characters. Celaena Sardothien is a complex and multi-dimensional protagonist. Initially hardened by her past and driven by her desire for vengeance, she gradually unravels layers of vulnerability, resilience, and strength. As the series progresses, Celaena's journey becomes intertwined with other compelling characters, such as the charismatic Captain of the Guard, Chaol Westfall, and the enigmatic Fae Prince, Rowan Whitethorn. The intricate relationships and evolving dynamics between these characters add depth and emotional resonance to the narrative.

The Throne of Glass series explores various themes, including power, sacrifice, friendship, and the struggle between good and evil. As Celaena embarks on her quest, she faces moral dilemmas and grapples with her own identity. He’s best known for The Little Princess. This series has lasted through the generations and has been adapted into a TV series for Channel 5’s Milkshake. Ross has illustrated all but two of his works, and his art is featured on theatre tours and merchandise accompanying them.

Ross’s has won the Silver Medal Smarties Prize, and his books have been shortlisted for awards, including Laugh Out Loud and the Kate Greenaway Medal. He has been both the best-selling and most-borrowed illustrator in the UK.

title: Touch and Feel Books
description:
Reading is a complex task that requires the use of many different skills. Developing these skills can be a challenge for young children who are just learning to read. One way to help them is to use touch and feel books, which can help make the process more enjoyable. These books have raised images or textures that children can explore with their hands.

For example, a touch and feel book about farm animals might have textured pages for different animals, such as a furry page for a sheep or a smooth page for a duck. The raised pictures and textures can help readers connect with the story and make the characters more concrete. This process allows them to develop a sense of how print works and associate words with specific objects or actions. 

Before children learn to read with sight, they first develop a love of books through touching and feeling them. Touch and feel books engage children's senses, sparking their curiosity and imagination. Many touch and feel books also include simple pictures and storylines, making them a great way to introduce young children to the world of reading. In addition, touch and feel books can also be used to teach basic concepts like colours, numbers or shapes. As a result, they are a valuable tool for helping children learn to read. With a bit of patience and practice, your child will be able to read with confidence in no time.

The textures in touch and feel books also help children develop fine motor skills. As children explore the different textures, they learn to use their hands in new ways, improving their dexterity.

In addition, touch and feel books provide opportunities for children to bond with their caregivers. As they share the experience of exploring the book together, they create lasting memories that will be cherished long after the book is closed. 

Learning to read is an important milestone for any child. However, reading can be a real challenge for children who are blind or have low vision. Traditional books are often not accessible, and Braille can be difficult to learn. Touch and feel books offer a unique solution since they are made for children to explore with their hands. As they touch and feel the different shapes and textures, they better understand the world around them. As a result, they are an invaluable tool for helping children with visual impairments learn to read.

title: V. E. Schwab Books
description:
V. E. Schwab is a talented American author who has created an incredible world of magic and adventure in her popular book series. Her stories are filled with complex characters, intricate plots, and fascinating world-building that will transport readers to other realms and leave them wanting more.

Born on July 7, 1987, in Nashville, Tennessee, Schwab grew up in a family that valued creativity and self-expression. She began writing at a young age and pursued her passion for storytelling throughout her childhood and teenage years. She had originally planned to study astrophysics but changed directions after taking art and literature courses. She graduated with a Bachelor of Fine Arts degree in 2009 from Washington University in St. Louis. 

Schwab’s first novel, The Near Witch, was published in 2011, and she quickly gained a reputation as a talented and inventive author. She sold her debut novel to Disney before graduating. Her breakthrough came in 2013 with the release of her novel Vicious, which introduced readers to a world where superpowers exist, but they are not necessarily used for good. The book was a critical and commercial success, and it cemented Schwab’s status as a rising star in the world of fantasy and science fiction.

Schwab’s most popular book series is the Shades of Magic trilogy, which includes A Darker Shade of Magic, A Gathering of Shadows, and A Conjuring of Light. These books take place in a world where magic exists, but it is limited to specific regions of the world, and only a select few are able to wield it. The story follows Kell, a powerful magician who can travel between different versions of London, and his ally, Lila, a thief with a thirst for adventure.

Schwab’s world-building in the Shades of Magic series is masterful, and readers will be transported to a fantastical realm that is both familiar and exotic. The characters are multi-dimensional, with their own unique personalities and motivations, and the plot is filled with twists and turns that will keep readers on the edge of their seats.

Her 2020 book The Invisible life of Addie LaRue became a TikTok sensation on #booktok, receiving much praise for her fantasy novel. The captivating novel tells the story of a young woman named Addie LaRue, who makes a deal with a god to live forever, but in exchange, is cursed to be forgotten by everyone she meets. Set in various locations across time, Addie's story unfolds as she navigates the challenges of life without connections and the longing for human interaction. That is until one day Henry Strauss utters the 3 most important words- “I remember you.”

Schwab has also written several standalone novels, including This Savage Song and City of Ghosts, both of which have received critical acclaim. This Savage Song takes place in a world where monsters are real, and it follows the unlikely alliance between two teenagers, one of whom is a human and the other is a monster. City of Ghosts tells the story of a girl who can see ghosts and her adventures in a haunted city.

In conclusion, V. E. Schwab is a talented and inventive author whose stories have captured the imaginations of readers around the world. Her books are full of magic, adventure, and excitement, and her characters are some of the most memorable in contemporary literature. Whether you are a fan of fantasy, science fiction, or just great storytelling, you won’t want to miss her work.

title: Video Game Books 🎮
description:
Book adaptations of video games have become increasingly popular in recent years as publishers seek to tap into the passionate and dedicated fanbases that these games have created. Some of the most popular video game franchises that have been adapted into books include Pokemon, Five Nights at Freddy's, and Minecraft.

Pokemon Books

Pokemon is one of the most iconic and beloved video game franchises in the world, and its book adaptations have been just as successful. The Pokemon series of books follows the adventures of Ash Ketchum and his friends as they journey through the various regions of the Pokemon world, capturing and battling with a wide variety of Pokemon. The books are targeted at a younger audience, like 7-9 but can be enjoyed by fans of all ages. They are full of action, adventure, and heartwarming moments that will make readers fall in love with the world of Pokemon all over again.

Check out the bestselling Pokemon Colossal Collection 16 Books Box Set by Tracy West! This whopping collection contains 16 books for kids to explore, meeting all of their favourite characters (and pokemon!) along the way. 

Five Nights at Freddy’s Books

Five Nights at Freddy's is a horror video game series that has been adapted into a number of novels and graphic novels. The series is known for its jump scares and creepy animatronic characters, and the books capture that same sense of fear and suspense. The books explore the lore and backstory of the Five Nights at Freddy's universe, revealing the dark secrets behind the animatronics and the twisted history of the various locations in the games. Fans aged 9-14 of horror and suspense will love the chilling atmosphere and tense moments of the Five Nights at Freddy's book adaptations.

Check out the horrifying tales of the killer animatronics in the Five Nights at Freddy’s 3 Books Collection by Scott Cawthon. This terrifying trilogy contains three stories surrounding the strange happenings of Freddy Fazbear’s Pizzeria. During the day, it's a place of joy... But you aren't here during the day. You have the night watch.

Minecraft Books

Finally, the Minecraft franchise, which has sold over 200 million copies since its initial release in 2011, has also inspired a range of book adaptations. Check out the Minecraft Guides Collection 8 Books Set by Mojang, from the bestselling sandbox survival video game series developed by Mojang Studios, Minecraft. With exclusive tips from the developers at Mojang, this Official Minecraft Guide Collection might just save your life- in the game, of course! Whether you’re a beginner or an expert, this collection makes for the perfect gift for any gamer to learn some handy tips and tricks to get better at the game and impress all their friends. 

While book adaptations of video games may seem like a niche market, they have become increasingly popular in recent years, and for a good reason. These books offer fans a new way to explore the worlds and characters they love, providing a deeper understanding of the lore and backstory of their favourite games. They also allow fans to engage with the material in a new way, bringing the stories and characters to life on the page in a way that is different from playing the games.

In addition to providing fans with a new way to experience their favourite games, book adaptations of video games can also be a great way to introduce new fans to the franchise. For example, a young reader who is not yet old enough to play the Five Nights at Freddy's games may be able to enjoy the books, allowing them to experience the world and characters in a way that is appropriate for their age level.

Overall, book adaptations of video games are a great way for fans to engage with their favourite franchises in a new way. Whether it's the action and adventure of Pokemon, the horror and suspense of Five Nights at Freddy's, or the survival of Minecraft, these books offer something for everyone. So if you're a fan of these video game franchises, be sure to check out the book adaptations to experience the worlds and characters you love in a whole new way.

Books for your little one

Picture books are also the building blocks that promote literacy, vocabulary skills, and basic sentence structure. This collection includes three titles: I Want My Hat Back, This Is Not My Hat, and We Found My Hat. This endearing tale tells of a bear whose hat is gone. And he wants it back. Patiently and politely, he asks each animal whether they have seen it. But just before he loses all hope, the bear quickly regains his memory and renews his search with a vengeance. Also known as the Chaos Walking Trilogy, Patrick Ness’ young adult science fiction series is set in a dystopian world that follows Todd Hewitt- the only boy in a town of men. Ever since the people of New World were infected with the Noise germ, all women were unable to survive, leaving all men able to hear each other’s thoughts. With only a month until Todd becomes a man, he knows the town is hiding a sinister secret from him. And when he is forced to flee with his only canine companion, whose simple and loyal voice he can hear too, the pair stumble upon a strange patch of silence and an unfamiliar creature: a girl. Warrior Cats 

Warrior Cats is a series based on the adventures of feral cats. There are multiple gangs of cats in the books. They occur predominantly in fictional forests and woodlands. There are five main clans in the Warrior series - ThunderClan, ShadowClan, RiverClan, WindClan and SkyClan. The books are perfect for readers aged 9-14-years-old but are also enjoyed by teens and adults. 

There are a total of eight series and over 40 books in the Warrior Cats books, as well as field guides, novellas and manga. The second series of books is called The New Prophecy, which has another six books starting with Midnight and continuing with Moonrise, Dawn, Starlight, Twilight and Sunset. The Warrior Cats books have numerous returning characters, and each series explores different clans. Each cat is feral, some were previously pets but are now wild, but they abide by the Warrior Cats Code. title: Watts Books
description:
"Reading Champion books are designed to appeal to every child, and feature diverse characters, vibrant artwork and contemporary topics. There’s lots of choice too, with over 150 books available for Reception, Key Stage 1 (ages 4-7) and Key Stage 2 (ages 7-11)." - Reading Champions

What is Reading Champion?

"Reading Champion is a series of fun, modern reading books specifically written to support independent reading ie. reading with little or no help from a teacher, parent or carer. Featuring vibrant artwork and exciting, contemporary topics, these books are designed to make children want to pick them up and start reading! Each book has been carefully graded so that it can be matched to a child’s reading ability, encouraging reading for pleasure." - Reading Champions

"Unlike other reading schemes, all Reading Champion books have been levelled according to UCL’s official criteria for independent reading. Key Stage 1 books support the band numbers and colours used in school. Key Stage 2 books are the only officially levelled books for this age group, so you can be confident of picking a book at the right reading level for each child." - Reading Champions

The Key Stage 2 Reading Champion Books are suggested for use as follows:

Independent Reading 11: start of Year 3 or age 7+
Independent Reading 12: end of Year 3 or age 7+
Independent Reading 13: start of Year 4 or age 8+
Independent Reading 14: end of Year 4 or age 8+
Independent Reading 15: start of Year 5 or age 9+
Independent Reading 16: end of Year 5 or age 9+
Independent Reading 17: start of Year 6 or age 10+
Independent Reading 18: end of Year 6 or age 10+

Check out Reading Champion's official website at reading-champion.co.uk

"Many reading schemes offer the same books for guided and independent reading. However Reading Champion has been specifically written to support independent reading and literacy consultants have worked with authors to ensure that each book provides the right level of challenge for reading unaided or with little help." - Reading Champions

What is independent reading?

"Independent reading is reading unaided or with little help, as opposed to guided reading at school where children have the support of a teacher, teaching assistant or reading helper.

It’s important to ensure that children are choosing independent reading books with the right level of challenge so that they enjoy the story. If the books are too easy children will not develop their reading skills, but if they are too hard then children can become frustrated. Reading Champion is specifically written for independent reading, so each book has been carefully graded to ensure it is at the right level for reading unaided." - Reading Champions

What are book bands?

"Books used for guided reading at school are usually assigned a coloured and/or numbered book band to indicate the level of challenge of the book, this helps to track a child’s reading progress.

Reading Champion is linked to book bands to help children select the right level books for independent reading. Key Stage 1 (4-7 year olds or Reception to Year 2) books are indicated by a coloured and numbered band (e.g. Yellow 3). Key Stage 2 books are indicated by the black logo and progress from level 11 (7 year olds or those in Year 3) to level 18 (11 year olds or those in Year 6). If your child is reading book band Turquoise 7 at school, then Reading Champion Turquoise 7 books should offer the right level of challenge for independent reading at home." - Reading Champions

How should I use Reading Champion with my child?

"Use the book band that your child is reading at school to help them choose a book that is at the right level for their ability. You should decide together whether your child will read the story independently or read it aloud to you. If reading aloud then you should support your child if they hesitate or ask for help. If reading to themselves, remind your child that they can come and ask for help if they get stuck.

Each book contains guidance notes for parents and carers using the books at home. These notes include questions to ask before they start reading, such as “Why did you choose this book? Why do you think you will enjoy it?”, as well as suggested questions and a fun comprehension activity for after they have read the book. These questions aim to help children learn to make good choices when choosing independent reading books, and support their comprehension of the story." - Reading Champions

title: Where's Wally Books
description:
Where's Wally? 

Where's Wally is an iconic British character that has been around for generations. The character began in puzzle books and has spread into an animated TV series, a comic strip, video games and real-life Where's Wally World Record attempts. 

History of Where's Wally 

Where's Wally is a children's puzzle book by the British illustrator Martin Handford. The first volume was published 21st September 1987 by Walker Books. The books became an instant success, with the books being printed around the world. In America, the series is called Where's Waldo, and many other name changes were made worldwide to suit their audiences better. For example, in Germany, Wally is called Walter, in France, he is called Charlie, and in Denmark, he is called Holger.

The books themselves feature twelve detailed 2-page illustrated spreads of different everyday locations like the zoo, the beach and the park. Wally is identified by his red-and-white-striped shirt, bobble hat, and glasses, but many illustrations contain red herrings involving the deceptive use of red-and-white striped objects. As the books progress, it becomes harder and harder to locate Wally, making the puzzles more challenging and lasting longer. 

Puzzles and Games 

A wide range of Where's Wally books have been published with various locations and adventures. Choosing the right book for you or your little one is tricky as there's so much choice! A great set with a fantastic selection of Where's Wally titles is Where's Wally? 6 Books Collection, which includes Where's Wally?, Where's Wally Now?, Where's Wally? In Hollywood and so much more. This set contains six Where's Wally books, a poster and puzzles. 

Another fantastic set is the Where's Wally Amazing Adventures and Activities 8 Books Bag Collection which contains over one hundred stickers, four activity books and four Where's Wally books. Making it a perfect pack for long journeys or hospital stays in which your little ones need something to keep them occupied. For holidays, check out Where's Wally? The Totally Essential Travel Collection is filled with postcards and classic Where's Wally puzzles to keep the kids busy. These brightly coloured activity books are great for playing together or individually, hours of fun are to be had whilst trying to locate sneaky Wally as he's hidden in the crowds. 

Where's Wally Books are great for children aged 5-7 but have been enjoyed by all ages for generations. title: Wiley Books
description:
Wiley & Sons Inc. also popular as Wiley Books is an American multinational publishing company founded in 1807 that focuses on academic publishing and instructional materials. The company also produces books, journals, and encyclopaedias, in print and digital, as well as online products and services, training materials, and educational materials for undergraduate, graduate, and continuing academic papers.

The company was first established in 1807 when Charles Wiley opened a print shop in Manhattan. The company was the publisher of 19th century American literary figures like James Fenimore Cooper, Washington Irving, Herman Melville, and Edgar Allan Poe, as well as of legal, religious, and other non-fiction titles. The firm however only took its current name in 1865 and Wiley & Sons Inc. eventually shifted its publishing focus to scientific, technical, and engineering subject areas, abandoning its literary interests.

Through the 20th century, the company expanded its publishing activities to the sciences, and higher education and managed to acquire several other academic publication houses across the world. More recently in 2021, Wiley acquired Hindawi and J&J Editorial. Wiley & Sons Inc. marked its bicentennial in 2007. In conjunction with the anniversary, the company published Knowledge for Generations: Wiley and the Global Publishing Industry, 1807-2007, depicting Wiley's role in the evolution of publishing against a social, cultural, and economic backdrop. Whilst academic books are their niche, Wiley Books also have some incredible educational and self help titles that we believe can help teens and parents navigate life. 

One of the many interesting and diverse titles from the Wiley publication house that teens will love is, Diary of a Brilliant Kid : Top Secret Guide to Awesomeness. Life, universe and awesomeness—the Diary of a Brilliant Kid is the "tweenager's" atlas for navigating life as a teenager. This interactive collection of stories, quotes, theories and yes, science, guides your child through the difficult years between ages 8 and 12 to help them make sense of themselves and the world around them. Everything is changing! And that's okay! It's actually more than okay—it's exciting. The changes your teen is going through are the opening salvo of your child’s gradual transition into "grownup," and it's the perfect time to help them define who they are, how they think and how they choose to face the world. Is it a lot? Yes. But this book can help your teen sort things out and come out the other side shining. The journal format gives away the plot. Spoiler Alert: the brilliant kid is your child! Buy them this book and help them realise they are a unique collection of talents and dreams and wants and surprises, and that they have an entire lifetime of awesomeness ahead of them!

Yesss! : The SUMO Secrets to Being a Positive, Confident Teenager. Another important book published by John Wiley & Sons Inc; for teenagers, this one has all the tools and resources to support teen readers with their mental health and wellbeing. This book will be invaluable in helping your teen make the most of being who they truly are. Psychologist and director of the Mind & Soul Foundation Discovered how to make the most of being You! YESSS! The SUMO Secrets to Being a Positive, Confident Teenager uncovers the secrets of overcoming the challenges and also embracing the opportunities of one of life's most difficult stages: the teenage years. YESSS! is full of vibrant, exciting advice that will motivate and equip readers to overcome the insecurities and confusion that can often characterise our teenage years.

Sunday Times bestselling author and speaker, Paul McGee aka The SUMO Guy, shows teenagers (and the parents who both care for and support them) how to harness practical strategies to: Take responsibility for their lives Own and understand their feelings Build a more positive mindset Develop a healthy image of themselves Realize that it's OK to not always feel OK Recover from setbacks and develop perseverance Aspire, set goals, and dare to dream Perfect for every teenager and all those involved in supporting them, YESSS! shows young people what it's like to live with confidence, resilience, hope, and happiness.

description:
To read or not to read, that is the question! Born in Stratford-Upon-Avon in the 16th century, William Shakespeare’s plays have influenced writers, novelists and dramatists in the modern age. These editions are the perfect resource for secondary school students studying Shakespeare, including further reading lists, preliminary classroom notes, and links to online resources. This title is suitable for all exam boards and recent GCSE specifications. 

About the Author: 

William Shakespeare was an English playwright, poet, and actor of the 16th century, born in Stratford upon Avon. Commonly referred to as the Bard, his works include 39 plays, 154 sonnets, and three narrative poems. His plays have been translated into every major language and are performed more often than any other playwright. He died in 1616 at aged 52, but the cause of his death remains a mystery. 

His early plays were primarily comedies and histories such as Henry VI, The Comedy of Errors, and The Taming of the Shrew. He is best known for his many tragedies, including Romeo and Juliet, Hamlet and King Lear. At the end of his career, he predominantly wrote “tragicomedies”, such as The Winter’s Tale and The Tempest. 

Even 400 years after his passing, Shakespeare remains relevant in the 21st century. The themes in his works are timeless, in conjunction with his influence on literature and the English language, and as a result, his works continue to be studied in schools worldwide.

title: Winnie and Wilbur Books
description:
Winnie and Wilbur, is a series of nineteen children’s picture books, written by Valerie Thomas and illustrated by Korky Paul. Since its inception in 1987, the series has sold more than seven million books, is hugely popular and has been translated into more than 10 languages. Following the success of the picture books, a series of 'young fiction' Winnie the Witch book sets were written by Laura Owen, also illustrated by Korky Paul. Also, an animated series based on the books was produced for Milkshake network.

The Winnie and Wilbur books revolve around Winnie (the witch), Wilbur (her cat) and each book covers their adventures. Winnie loves her cat. She also loves her orange and yellow stripy tights, pumpkin soup, and waving her magic wand. Winnie, however, can't find her beloved cat Wilbur in her house, because both her house and Wilbur are black. Everything in Winnie's house is black—the carpet, the chairs, the bed and the sheets, the pictures on the walls, and even the bathtub! And of course her cat, Wilbur, is black too—all except for his bright-green eyes. Whenever poor Wilbur closes his eyes and tries to take a catnap, Winnie stumbles right over him. Or accidentally sits on top of him. Until one day, when Winnie gets a brilliant idea. What if Wilbur were a different colour?

This is when Winnie uses magic to turn Wilbur into a variety of colours, each one of which leads to a variety of mishaps and makes Wilbur miserable. After some spells that make Wilbur look very silly, Winnie finds just the right magic to make sure she can always see him. It's a colourful Winnie and Wilbur adventure! After much ado, Winnie turns Wilbur back to his original colour and changes the colour of her house instead.

This spellbinding bestselling series celebrates the wonderful relationship that exists between the witch and her big black cat; each book in the series makes for a captivating adventure on its own. Whilst the plotlines of these books keep the kids glued to the pages; Korky Paul's intricate artwork is also full of madcap humour and crazy details to look forward to.

Winnie and Wilbur books in order

One of the bestselling titles from the series is Winnie and Wilbur: The Festival of Witches by Valerie Thomas. Winnie and Wilbur are on their annual visit to the Worldwide Witches' Festival, meeting witches (and their cats) from all over the globe! They have a wonderful time partying, dancing and learning new spells. When the festival is over, Winnie and Wilbur hop on their broomstick and zoom off on a magical mystery tour to visit their new friends in a tropical treehouse, a castle by the sea and a house on top of a mountain. When they arrive back home, it's much too quiet but then there's a knock at the door.

A jubilant and joyful story celebrating diversity and friendship, as Winnie and Wilbur discover how magical it is to make new friends and be part of a global community of witches. Korky Paul's intricate and spellbinding artwork is full of fun, mischief and mayhem! The best-selling Winnie and Wilbur series has been delighting readers both young and old since 1987 and Winnie and Wilbur have become favourite characters in homes and schools all over the world.

Another one of our favourites from the series is the Winnie and Wilbur: Winnie's Best Friend by Valerie Thomas. This is the Winnie and Wilbur story of how their friendship began. When Winnie moves into her big house, it's much too quiet. Winnie invites her sisters to stay, then some unusual companions - and chaos ensues! Winnie wonders if she'll be alone forever - until she spots a scruffy black cat. A heart-warming and hilarious tale revealing the origins of a truly magical friendship. Korky Paul's intricate and spellbinding artwork is full of fun, mischief and mayhem!

title: Winnie the Pooh Books
description:
Join us at Books2Door as we journey into the timeless classic of A.A. Milne's Winnie the Pooh collection! Since its debut in 1926 with Winnie- the- Pooh, this beloved series and its characters have held a special place in our hearts. Pooh, the adorable and iconic teddy bear, alongside Piglet, a small yet loyal pig; Eeyore, the gloomy grey donkey, and Tigger, the energetic bouncer, have captured our imaginations for generations. Owl, Rabbit, Kanga, and Roo are alongside them, each adding their unique charm to this enchanting tale.

Step into the world of the Hundred Acre Wood, inspired by the honest Ashdown Forest in East Sussex, England, as we proudly present this captivating collection. The first-ever Winnie the Pooh book, published in 1926, still resonates today, followed by The House at Pooh Corner in 1928. These endearing characters were inspired by Milne's son Christopher's toy animals, with the original Winnie the Pooh being his stuffed bear, Edward.

Pooh also appeared in classic poetry books such as When We Were Very Young (1924) and Now We Are Six. The series continued with books like Return to the Hundred Acre Wood. In 1961, Disney acquired the rights to Winnie-the-Pooh, introducing him to a broader audience through films like Winnie the Pooh and the Honey Tree (1966).

Despite Pooh's self-proclaimed “Very Little Brain", he often finds himself in tricky situations, navigating them with simplicity and wit, appealing to young and adult readers. While the stories are whimsical and silly, Milne's work also provides profound insights into human behaviour.

Through Pooh's escapades, readers learn valuable life lessons, such as the importance of pausing and reflecting. Our collection, suitable for ages 0-5, provides the perfect opportunity for bonding between parents and children, creating cherished memories that will last a lifetime. Join us on this enchanting journey with Winnie the Pooh and his friends at Books2Door.

To help make back-to-school shopping so much easier, we’ve got an extensive collection of Key Stage One books, featuring some of the most famous and well-loved publishers from Penguin to Usborne that are perfect for all our little readers aged 5-6. Reading widely and often increases your child’s vocabulary because they encounter words that they would rarely hear or use in everyday speech. As a result, your child starts to build on and extend their own bank of vocabulary which will help them as they progress through school. Browse through our selection of top teachers’ picks, with plenty of variety there should be something for everyone. From well-loved characters such as Roger Hargreaves’ Mr Men and Little Miss collection to the Ultimate Peppa Pig collection, or even something brand new for little independent readers that want to try reading something completely different.

In these early stages of primary school, reading in Year One is a crucial skill that allows children to open the doors to countless learning opportunities. But it doesn’t have to be all work and no play. In fact, reading for children of all ages should be fun and exciting, exposing them to new and amusing characters that teach them important lessons along the way. Children learn best by observing, questioning and exploring the world around them, in the same way, reading encourages children to apply these same skills to understand and make sense of their environment in a stimulating and engaging way. At Books2Door, we have a fantastic selection of recommended primary school books that are affordable and quality, perfectly directed for readers aged 5-7 and also complement the school curriculum. 

Early Readers Books

For early readers beginning their own reading journey, why not try Ladybird I'm Ready for Phonics 12 Book Collection, the perfect book for 5-year-olds? In the early phonics stage, these fun and bright books are a fantastic way to introduce phonics to your little ones. As parents guide their child through levels 1-12 at their own pace, they will start to be able to recognise initial letter sounds at the beginning of simple words including crucial vowel and consonant sounds. Guided reading with an adult helps to feed your child’s imagination and opens up a treasure-house of wonder and joy for curious young minds. 

Or why not have a go at the Reading Ladder My First Read-Along Library 30 Books Box Set? Ranging from levels 1-3, this set is fantastic for all Key Stage 1 readers varying from short stories for new readers to chapter books for more advanced readers. Skilled word reading involves both the working out of the pronunciation of unfamiliar printed words and the recognition of familiar printed words. Through the practice of recognising both of these things, your child will be able to understand that the letters on the page represent the sounds in spoken words which will help children as they build on decoding sounds through consistent reading and comprehension. This is why phonics should be emphasised in the early teaching of reading to beginners at the start of Key Stage 1.

Picture Books
